title: process.loadEnvFile() is not covered by the .env rail
severity_rationale: S4, equal to the estimate: nothing uses it.

evidence.note: process.loadEnvFile reads the file through native code, not the wrapped fs

evidence.ref: git grep -n loadEnvFile -- src scripts test

sibling_sites_checked: node --env-file is refused by spawnRailedChild. dotenv goes through fs and is blocked. No other loader was found.
recommendation: Add a process.loadEnvFile wrapper to core.cjs if the rails are extended.
